restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r1-prefix-v1 only (one partial round plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on two lines and gives no claim for other round counts.

One attempt of the program; the claimed success probability 0.4999999999 is the lower bound proved in proof.md section 9 (counting lemma times the root-isolation bound 1 - 2^-36, minus the sampler failure 2^-127) and uses independent uniform random words as the model primitive.

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 describe the executed program of proof.md section 11 under the stated rules: 1 per field operation, 1 per element load or store plus 1 address operation, 3 per loop iteration plus 2 per loop exit, 1 per other executed index or control operation, 237 per reduced permutation evaluation, and a 16-word register file per transform block as the only register assumption.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the program of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 78125 for the main powering, N = 196608 and N' = 98304 in its transforms, 98304 evaluations per family).
heuristics.extrapolation: None for the data-independent stages (they are executed totals). The data-dependent stages (classical gcd, deflation, root isolation) are charged at derived bounds that the program asserts against its own counters at every execution.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; the source is part of the proof text and was not run by the organizer. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.

heuristics.statement: In the worst-case bound of the root isolation, the charge of one level of degree d' <= d is at most 1.02 times the charge measured at degree d for the Taylor shift and for Z^((p-1)/2) mod G; the gcd and division parts are derived bounds.
heuristics.scope: Stage F of proof.md section 7, levels d = 78125, 39062, ... , 4 (about 0.4 percent comes from the length of the exponent prefix, which varies by one step per power of two; the factor 1.02 covers it).
heuristics.extrapolation: From the measured charge at each level's maximum degree to every smaller degree at that level.
heuristics.limitations: Not run for every degree. It affects only the charged time of a branch that is entered with probability below 2^-36 beyond the level d = 3 and not the success probability.
